traits.Amphibious: The gremlin can breathe air and water.
traits.Pack Tactics: The gremlin has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and that ally isn't incapacitated.
traits.Thief of Small Things: Anything not fastened down and small enough to carry in two hands goes into the water within a round of the gremlin touching it, and is not seen again.

actions.name: Hooked Pole
actions.note: On a hit against a creature standing in water, the target must succeed on a DC 11 Strength saving throw or be pulled prone.
